notes: Adobe publishes no state or per-country headcounts. The FY2024 10-K gives employees only as U.S. vs. international (50/50), and the CSR data tables give workspace as U.S. 62% / India 23% / rest of world 14% (sums to 99% as printed). The U.S. appears twice in 'countries', once per metric, because the employee share comes from the 10-K and the workspace share from the CSR report. The CSR PDF on adobe.com returned 403 (Akamai) to curl; it was fetched this session through the WebFetch tool and read with pdftotext, so automated re-verification of the spaceShare rows and the Hillsboro site may hit the same block. Sites: San Jose HQ and the two Indian offices from 10-K Item 2; the owned Hillsboro, OR data center from the CSR environmental table. The 10-K's revenue-by-region shares (Americas/EMEA/APAC) are deliberately not repeated.
